About this item

  • FHD IPS DISPLAY - 15.6 inch Full HD IPS display with anti-glare coating and wide viewing angles for clear everyday visuals.
  • INTEL PROCESSOR N100 - Designed to provide affordable performance for browsing, streaming, learning, and daily tasks.
  • 4 GB MEMORY AND 128 GB UFS - Includes DDR4 memory and UFS storage for everyday performance and lower power consumption.
  • MICROSOFT 365 PERSONAL INCLUDED - Includes a 1-year Microsoft 365 Personal subscription for added everyday productivity.
  • INTEL UHD GRAPHICS - Integrated graphics support smooth everyday entertainment and streaming.
  • WI-FI 6 AND BLUETOOTH 5.4 - Helps provide reliable wireless connectivity across compatible networks and devices.
  • HP TRUE VISION 720P HD CAMERA - Supports clear video calls with temporal noise reduction and dual array digital microphones.
  • HP FAST CHARGE - Recharge the battery from 0 to 50% in approximately 45 minutes.
  • BUILT-IN PRIVACY FEATURES - Includes a camera privacy shutter and dedicated mic mute key for added confidence.
  • EPEAT GOLD REGISTERED - Designed with recycled plastics and certified ENERGY STAR for more sustainable everyday computing.

Product description

The HP 15.6 inch Laptop PC delivers practical everyday performance in a simple, connected design. Powered by an Intel Processor N100, it features a 15.6 inch FHD IPS anti-glare display, 4 GB DDR4 memory, and 128 GB UFS storage. Stay connected with Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.4, make clear video calls with the HP True Vision 720p HD camera, and get added value with a 1-year Microsoft 365 Personal subscription included.

        I ordered this HP 15.6-inch laptop as a birthday gift for myself when I turned 40, and I’ve been using it for about a month now. It has been working amazingly well for my everyday needs.

        The setup was simple and quick. The display is bright and clear, and it handles regular tasks like browsing, streaming, and document work smoothly. The design looks sleek, and it feels lightweight and easy to carry around.

        For the price, I think it’s a great choice for anyone who needs a dependable laptop for home or work use. I’m very satisfied with the performance so far and would definitely recommend it.
